limitations: Untextured full topology retained; UV seams are not exported because no textures are used.
Material boundaries use majority upstream vertex-group membership.
Baked joint poses interpolate as morph deltas, not exact continuous joint rotations.
GNM expressions are not the separate Audio2Motion representation.
